claim.claim-text: a cylindrically shaped body that defines an internal volume having (i) a longitudinal axis, (ii) an overall shape that is symmetric about the longitudinal axis, and (iii) a radius having a maximum radial distance at an interior surface of the enclosure and that is perpendicular to the longitudinal axis, the cylindrically shaped body having a first opening at a first end characterized as having a first diameter and a second opening that connects the internal volume to an external environment is axially disposed from the first opening and is characterized as having a second diameter, wherein the second opening allows access to a control input and a carrying handle; and components separate from the cylindrically shaped body , the components including:

a first printed circuit board (PCB) having a rectangular shape defined by a first dimension perpendicular to a second dimension, wherein the first PCB is offset from the longitudinal axis such that the first dimension is aligned to the longitudinal axis and the second dimension is perpendicular to the longitudinal axis, a second printed circuit board (PCB) centered at and perpendicular to the longitudinal axis, and an air moving component capable of providing the acoustic output by moving air in a manner that is aligned with the longitudinal axis and towards the first opening.
2. The computing system as recited in claim 1 wherein the the first opening is disposed opposite the second opening.
3. The computing system as recited in claim 2 wherein the second PCB is located in proximity to the second opening.

4. The computing system as recited in claim 1 further comprising a third printed circuit board (PCB) offset from the longitudinal axis, perpendicular to the first and second PCBs and coupled to and capable of receiving a signal from the control input.
5. The computing system as recited in claim 4 wherein the signal is capable of controlling the acoustic output of the air moving component.
6. The computing system as recited in claim 2 further comprising a base support unit separably coupled to the cylindrically shaped body at the second opening.
7. The computing system as recited in claim 6 wherein the base support unit is capable of supporting the cylindrically shaped body on a horizontal surface and in a vertical orientation.
8. The computing system as recited in claim 6 wherein the base support unit is centered at perpendicular to the longitudinal axis.
9. The computing system as recited in claim 6 wherein the base support unit includes a power receptacle capable of receiving external power.
10. The computing system as recited in claim 1 wherein the cylindrically shaped body comprises:

a first part symmetrically disposed about the longitudinal axis , wherein the first part comprises the first opening and the second opening , disposed opposite the first opening; and a second part separably joined to the first part, wherein the second part is centered at and perpendicular to the longitudinal axis such that the second part is capable of supporting the first part in a vertical orientation on a horizontal surface.
11. The computing system as recited in claim 10 wherein the first and second parts are separably joined.

12. The computing system as recited in claim 1 further comprising a base centered at and perpendicular to the longitudinal axis, wherein the base is separably coupled to the cylindrically shaped body at a distal end and is capable of supporting the tubular enclosure in a vertical orientation on a horizontal surface.
13. The computing system as recited in claim 1 wherein the acoustic output provided by the moving air corresponds to an audible sound.
14. The computing system as recited in claim 13 wherein the signal modulates characteristics of the audible sound.

15. The computing system as recited in claim 13 wherein acoustic characteristics of the audible sound is, at least in part, modulated by a control signal and the modulation of the acoustic characteristics is discernable outside of the cylindrically shaped body.
